item.title: EplayerX 1.2.16
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 下载视频时可同时保存匹配的外挂字幕及弹幕文件，方便离线播放。 - 下载管理支持补充下载或重试字幕及附属文件，并显示保存状态。 - 改善离线播放的字幕选择，避免在线字幕偏好影响已下载的字幕。 - 改善部分 HEVC 视频的硬件解码兼容性，以及解码异常后的播放恢复。
已知问题：系统下载服务异常失效后，下载任务可能停滞。可尝试完全退出并重新打开应用后重试。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Video downloads can now save matching external subtitles and danmaku files for offline playback. - Download management now supports downloading or retrying subtitles and sidecar files, with save status shown in the list. - Improved subtitle selection during offline playback so online subtitle preferences do not override downloaded subtitles. - Improved hardware decoding compatibility for some HEVC videos and playback recovery after decoder errors.
Known issue: downloads may stall after the system download service invalidates its session. If this happens, try quitting and reopening the app before retrying.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
